dct_title_s: British Indian Ocean Territory Roads (OpenStreetMap Export)
dct_description_sm: This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching ( Learn what tags means [here](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Tags) ) : tags['highway'] IS NOT NULL Features may have these attributes: - [name](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name) - [name:en](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name:en) - [highway](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:highway) - [surface](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:surface) - [smoothness](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:smoothness) - [width](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:width) - [lanes](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:lanes) - [oneway](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:oneway) - [bridge](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:bridge) - [layer](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:layer) - [source](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:source) This dataset is one of many [OpenStreetMap exports on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot). See the [Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team](http://hotosm.org/) website for more information.
